title: review: fix round 1 for T-0801: rebase onto goal/T-0760, keep packet-only render inside the new try/except
spec: Fix round 1 for T-0801: branch task/T-0801 (worktree wt/T-0801, commit 033023e) conflicts with goal/T-0760 in orchestrator/daemon.py around dispatch(): T-0799 (already merged) changed the execute render call to spawn.render("execute", packet=packet) with no spec/acceptance/scope kwargs, while this branch wrapped the old three-kwarg call in the new try/except. Resolution: run `git fetch` then `git rebase goal/T-0760` in the worktree; in the conflict keep the try/except structure from this branch and the packet-only render call from goal/T-0760 (spawn.render("execute", packet=packet)); no other hunks conflict. Then run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green and finish the rebase with the branch history intact (no merge commit). Never re-add the spec/acceptance/scope kwargs.
acceptance: orchestrator/daemon.py dispatch renders the execute prompt with spawn.render("execute", packet=packet) inside the try/except that holds the task on error (resolved by rebasing task/T-0801 onto goal/T-0760, keeping this branch's try/except and the goal branch's packet-only render call)
git merge-base task/T-0801 goal/T-0760 equals the goal/T-0760 head after the rebase (branch is rebased, not merged)

result.summary: Verified in wt/T-0801 (HEAD 6ca204e, rebased from 033023e): merge-base(task/T-0801, goal/T-0760) equals goal/T-0760 head, confirming a true rebase not a merge. The committed diff matches the packet spec exactly — dispatch() keeps the try/except holding the task on error, calls spawn.render("execute", packet=packet) with no reintroduced spec/acceptance/scope kwargs, and moves meta/spawn_async inside the try. Ran the two named acceptance tests directly (both pass) and the full tests/test_daemon.py suite (210 tests, all pass). hold_render_error remains used elsewhere (_dispatch_fresh_fix), so it's not dead code. No issues found.
